Lane peaks petitioned and granted are in docs/prose-naturalization/keeps-petitions/pallass.json.

The three MARKET STALL observes are the named exception -- reviewer M3 required them differentiated, so two of the three were rewritten and the "Efficient. Impersonal." doublet survives on market_stall_a only.
_qa_pins_broken_note: Unchanged at 8 by the fix wave: every fix-wave edit either lands on a string already in this list (pallass_ledger_skill[14], pallass_peek[177], pallass_ledger_carry[32]) or on a string no QA script pins (grepped repo-wide over qa/ and tests/). deltas.old: [Appraise Goods] — Form nine, clause four: perishable household stock is exempt from queue hold. Tin is not perishable. The salt packed WITH it is, and it is on the same manifest line. Four cycles, and the exemption was on the paper the whole time.
deltas.new: [Appraise Goods] — Form nine, clause four: perishable household stock is exempt from queue hold. The tin is not perishable, the salt packed with it is, and after four cycles both are still on one manifest line, so the exemption covers the crate.
deltas.why: bible §8: bare CAPS emphasis (WITH) banned at zero; §1.4 4 sentences in functional/skill-outcome; §1.1 thematic closer. All facts kept (form nine clause four, exemption, tin/salt, four cycles, one manifest line); the tin/salt correction is a §7 legitimate keep (the player needs it) || FIX WAVE (M1): review M1: the lane's rewrite left the chain with no resolution — the player spends [Appraise Goods], finds the exemption, and the receipt never says the exemption applies. Restored as a short resolution clause on the existing sentence (no new button, no irony, no re-statement). All facts still present: form nine clause four, perishable exemption, queue hold, tin/salt, four cycles, one manifest line.

deltas.new: You put a hand on the rail. Warm from the tier, not from the drop, and cold air comes up the shaft against your wrist.

deltas.old: One crate of tin, den shop, market tier. Logged three cycles running and carried none of them. Beside it, in a tidier hand: HELD, QUEUE.

deltas.old: The pallet is where you left it and the cage is where the bell says. Nothing moves again until the next shift.

Reconciled in the toast alone (the observe is holdout, byte-untouched): refusal = the attendant has stopped counting loads for the day, re-arm = tomorrow's bell, and the pallet's position is left where the observe puts it. Ending shape INSTRUCTION, deliberately unlike $.entities[14].once_per_waking_toast's fact ending in the same file.
